question: Should this dashboard automation change require live Actions proof before merge, or is source/test evidence enough for this PR?
rationale: The diff changes GitHub Actions trigger behavior, and static tests cannot prove live workflow_run, schedule, and manual dispatch behavior or the telemetry freshness tradeoff.

options.title: Require live Actions proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Actions run link, API transcript, or logs showing completion events no longer start dashboard-ci while scheduled or manual refresh still works.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: Merge on source and regression-test evidence while explicitly accepting up to five-minute dashboard CI telemetry freshness without a live trigger transcript.

recommendation.title: Require live Actions proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Actions run link, API transcript, or logs showing completion events no longer start dashboard-ci while scheduled or manual refresh still works.

likelyOwner.reason: The same handle is the strongest history signal for the dashboard-ci workflow and current PR branch, though final proof override authority still belongs to repository maintainers.
